speaker: Unknown
en: But how does that then cascade through the rest of the economy?

speaker: Unknown
en: You're going from this sort of agent as like a foreground harness that you talk to on a local computer to agents that are deployed online and then also sort of wired in online.
zh: 你正在从这种作为一种前景线束的智能体——你在本地计算机上与之对话——转变为部署在线上的智能体，然后也在线上连接。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so our focus at Electric, we've always been like kind of data infrastructure for building collaborative multi-user software.
zh: 所以我们在 Electric 的重点，我们一直有点像是为构建协作式多用户软件而设的数据基础设施。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 现在这意味着某种多用户、多智能体系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we're particularly focused on this thing like where you sort of bring agents online and suddenly you've got like lots of agents and agents and people are all part of kind of how you get work done.
zh: 所以我们特别关注像这样的东西，你把智能体带到线上，突然你有了很多智能体，智能体和人都成为了你如何完成工作的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do you do the communication, coordination, data wiring for those types of systems?
zh: 你如何为这些类型的系统进行通信、协调和数据布线？

speaker: Unknown
en: But is this just, you know,
zh: 但这只是，你知道，

speaker: Unknown
en: The big shift which is the whole main shift in the agent economy is like agents have the potential to automate work that can be more efficient how do you actually switch your company from running on people to running on a hybrid of people and agents like what's the infrastructure for that?
zh: 最大的转变，也就是智能体经济中整个主要的转变，就像智能体有潜力自动化工作，这可以更有效率，你实际上如何将你的公司从运行在人身上转变为运行在人+智能体的混合体上，那其中的基础设施是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: And do you think there's any things that you're seeing that not many others have like you've noticed that like maybe other people aren't seeing as clearly?
zh: 你认为你看到的东西里有没有什么不是很多其他人也有的，就像你注意到了一些可能其他人看得不那么清楚的东西？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, I mean, I think, I wouldn't say we're like the only ones to see a lot of the stuff that we see, but I think there is a big difference between a lot of the people who are actually working at the front of market with managed agents, online agents, multi-agent systems, and sort of most people's perception of agent infrastructure.
zh: 是的，我的意思是，我想，我不会说我们是唯一看到我们看到很多东西的人，但我认为很多实际上在市场前沿工作的人，那些使用托管智能体、在线智能体、多智能体系统的人，与大多数人对智能体基础设施的认知之间存在很大差异。

speaker: Unknown
en: So most people, if you think, right, okay, I need to run an agent online, you take a harness, which kind of is the agent, like a kind of Claude code or an open code.
zh: 所以大多数人，如果你想，好吧，我需要在线上运行一个智能体，你会拿一个线束，它有点像是智能体，就像 Claude code 或 open code 那种。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the thing about those is like, if you run it locally, you have like dangerously allowable permissions.
zh: 关键是那些东西就像，如果你在本地运行它，你有危险的允许权限。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the whole thing of these kind of agent harnesses was going, oh my God, LLMs are really good at using the computer.
zh: 这些智能体线束的整个事情是，天哪，LLM 真的很擅长使用计算机。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's kind of just let them sort of run on a computer.
zh: 所以让我们就让它们在计算机上运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so they need a file system and they do bash and grep and these types of tool calls.
zh: 所以它们需要文件系统，它们做 bash 和 grep 以及这些类型的工具调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that's why when you think of how do I bring an agent online, you kind of take that harness and you put it into like a Docker container or a sandbox or a VM of some sort.
zh: 所以这就是为什么当你考虑如何把一个智能体上线时，你会把那个套件放到一个 Docker 容器或者沙箱或某种虚拟机里。

speaker: Unknown
en: because you think you need to give the agent a computer yeah uh and we see that as more of an anti-pattern there's kind of there's sort of two main reasons one is that if you then have that model where the agent like like if i use claude on my local computer where are my agent sessions if i tell claude to do some research spawning sub-agents where are the session logs from the sub-agents and the answer is actually there's like json lines files in a hidden folder on my computer
zh: 因为你认为你需要给智能体一台电脑，是啊，呃，我们认为这更像是一种反模式，这主要有两个原因，一个是如果你有那个模型，智能体就像……就像如果我在我的本地电脑上使用 Claude，我的智能体会话在哪里？如果我告诉 Claude 做一些研究，生成子智能体，那些子智能体的会话日志在哪里？答案实际上是我电脑上一个隐藏文件夹里的 JSON Lines 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you think of that from the perspective of like a business that might need to go, well, hang on, why did you create that artifact?
zh: 如果你从一个企业的角度考虑这个问题，企业可能需要说，好吧，等等，你为什么要创建那个产物？

speaker: Unknown
en: Where are the decision traces?
zh: 决策跟踪在哪里？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, they're just buried.
zh: 嗯，它们只是被埋没了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you then port that just into like a harness running in a sandbox online, it's equally buried because what are you going to do?
zh: 如果你只是把它移植到一个在线沙箱中运行的套件里，它同样被埋没了，因为你要做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: SSH into the sandbox?
zh: SSH 进那个沙箱吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: You've got to find a way of kind of actually like wiring up the stuff that the agent is doing into systems that you can actually query and see.
zh: 你必须找到一种方法，把智能体正在做的事情真正连接到你可以实际查询和看到的系统中。

speaker: Unknown
en: So sort of standard web infrastructure.
zh: 所以是标准的 Web 基础设施。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've all been on this thing of like 20 years of moving organizations to the cloud.
zh: 我们都经历了这 20 年将组织迁移到云端的过程。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so web stuff is all very naturally like wired in with like instrumentation and Prometheus and Datadog and Clearhouse and whatnot.
zh: 所以 Web 东西都很自然地与检测以及 Prometheus、Datadog 和 Clearhouse 之类的东西连接在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: But kind of agents are sort of weirdly being deployed as these like sort of black box containers.
zh: 但是智能体有点奇怪地被部署为这些黑盒容器。

speaker: Unknown
en: So one thing is the kind of fragmentation, but then the other thing is more just that it models agents as compute.
zh: 一个是碎片化问题，但另一点更多的是它把智能体建模为计算。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the key thing about agents that we see is that agents are not compute, they are data.
zh: 所以关于智能体，我们要看到的关键点是智能体不是计算，它们是数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: So like, what is an agent?
zh: 那么，什么是智能体？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well...

speaker: Unknown
en: what we see it more as is like the agent is the session log so say you have an agent and that could be like an agent that is doing a process in a kind of pr work in a ci workflow or it could be you have an agent like for a pr or it could be an agent for like an object in this room and like you're just going to have a huge number of agents for everything it's like every step in every work process every customer interaction every like touch point that you could work with
zh: 我们更多把它看作是智能体就是会话日志，所以假设你有一个智能体，那可能是一个在 CI 工作流中做 PR 工作流程的智能体，或者你可能有一个用于 PR 的智能体，或者可能是一个这个房间里某个物体的智能体，就像你将拥有一切事物的海量智能体，这就像每个工作流程中的每一步，每一次客户互动，每一个你可以合作的接触点。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have all those agents and you run them all as like a VM and they've all got like two gigabytes of memory, then it's just insanely inefficient.
zh: 如果你有所有那些智能体，并且把它们都像虚拟机一样运行，它们都有两个千兆字节的内存，那就太低效了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also if you model the agent as compute and if you then kill the compute, well, the agent isn't there.
zh: 而且，如果你把智能体建模为计算，然后你终止了计算，那么智能体就不在了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you obviously need this model where you'd be like, okay, I'm interacting with this agent, I'm kind of finished, so let's like hibernate it or kind of scale it down.
zh: 但你显然需要这种模型，你会说，好吧，我正在和这个智能体交互，我差不多完成了，所以让我们休眠它或者缩减它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then say, I want to come back and talk to that same agent session or fork the agent session.
zh: 然后说，我想回来和那个同一个智能体会话对话，或者分叉那个智能体会话。

speaker: Unknown
en: You basically need the session log and the state in the data layer so you can rerun the compute.
zh: 你基本上需要数据层中的会话日志和状态，这样你就可以重新运行计算。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so when you think of agents as like logical entities, you realize that they exist even when they're not running, which is why if you model them as compute, it's just wrong because they don't live in the compute.
zh: 所以当你把智能体看作逻辑实体时，你意识到即使它们不运行时它们也是存在的，这就是为什么如果你把它们建模为计算，那就完全错了，因为它们并不存在于计算中。

speaker: Unknown
en: They actually live in the durability layer in the data layer.
zh: 它们实际上存在于持久层中，在数据层中。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, that's very interesting.
zh: 好的，这非常有意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: So don't give agents computers.
zh: 所以不要给智能体电脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well then if you think about okay so how do you actually then do that because you're like well I don't want to just like I've got to actually run my tool calls and I also don't want like my agents rampaging over some sort of general server.
zh: 那么如果你想一想，好吧，那你实际上该怎么做呢，因为你就像，嗯，我不想只是……我必须实际运行我的工具调用，而且我也不想让我的智能体在某种通用服务器上横冲直撞。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want isolation and you do need like tool call execution.
zh: 你需要隔离，你也确实需要工具调用执行。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you think if you look at this more sort of managed agent pattern what you can do is separate the agent logic from the tool call execution.
zh: 但是如果你想一下，如果你看看这种更像是托管智能体的模式，你能做的是将智能体逻辑与工具调用执行分离开来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then it's a bit like the idea of, say, say you're trying to generate a data report using an agent for a data analyst.
zh: 然后这有点像这个想法，比如说，假设你正试图使用一个为数据分析师准备的智能体来生成数据报告。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you get your agent to hallucinate out the CSV file or do you send a SQL query to a database, which is actually just like a normal data system or data platform that's running under your control that actually exports out the data by executing the query plan?
zh: 你是让你的智能体幻觉生成出那个 CSV 文件，还是你向数据库发送一个 SQL 查询，这实际上就像是一个正常运行在你控制之下的普通数据系统或数据平台，它通过执行查询计划实际导出数据？

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's that same switch.
zh: 这就是同样的切换。

speaker: Unknown
en: So where you have a tool call execution, which might be like, you know, grep files, where increasingly, like, there was this cool project today, like Miracle came out, there's like Just Bash, there's all these like emulation layers, which look to the agent like they're using the computer, but means you can actually fulfill things like file operations and tool call executions using sort of proper online systems.
zh: 所以在你有工具调用的地方，这可能是，你知道的，grep 文件，现在越来越多的是，就像今天有个很酷的项目，Miracle 出来了，还有 Just Bash，有所有这些仿真层，它们对智能体来说看起来像是在使用电脑，但这意味着你可以实际使用某种正规的在线系统来完成文件操作和工具调用执行之类的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that's the switch where you go, you don't have a sandbox which bundles it all together.
zh: 所以这就是那个切换，你不再有一个把所有东西打包在一起的沙箱。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can just have, you can have like a function, like a VA isolate or however you do like a Cloudflare worker or an edge function that is capable of running expressive agent logic, including things like code mode and code execution.
zh: 你可以只有一个函数，像一个 VA isolate 或者无论你如何实现一个 Cloudflare worker 或边缘函数，它能够运行富于表现力的智能体逻辑，包括代码模式和代码执行之类的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then when you come to doing something like...
zh: 但是当你来做类似……

speaker: Unknown
en: create an artifact or query a data system that should go back into like traditional data platform stuff because then also you can kind of monitor it and ensure quality and that's sort of deterministic software that you can control so that's this architecture where in a way more scalable managed online agents move to agents and functions separated from the tool call execution with the durability in the session log
zh: 创建一个产物或查询一个数据系统的事情时，这应该回到传统的数据平台的东西，因为那样你也可以监控它并确保质量，那是你可以控制的某种确定性软件，这就是这种架构，在某种程度上更可扩展的托管在线智能体转向了智能体和函数与工具调用执行分离，并且持久化在会话日志中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you read the kind of Anthropic Managed Agents paper, if you read the Cloudflare Project Think paper, this is the architecture which they and others have all converged on.
zh: 如果你读一下那篇 Anthropic Managed Agents 论文，如果你读一下 Cloudflare Project Think 论文，这就是他们和其他人都趋同的架构。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so what we're trying to do at Electric is we obviously come at things from the data layer.
zh: 所以我们在 Electric 努力做的事情是，我们显然是从数据层来处理事情的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're just trying to provide the primitives for any platform builder or product builder to build the same kind of infrastructure, but without the platform lock-in that would come from, like, if you have to use, like, Anthropic's amazing, right?
zh: 我们只是试图为任何平台构建者或产品构建者提供原语来构建同一种基础设施，但没有那种平台锁定，那种锁定来自于，比如说，你必须使用，比如说，Anthropic 的东西，很棒，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: But obviously, Anthropic want you to use Claude.
zh: 但显然，Anthropic 想让你使用 Claude。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the Cloudflare stack is totally amazing for agents, like durable objects, agents SDK is awesome.
zh: 而且 Cloudflare 栈对智能体来说完全棒极了，比如 Durable Objects，agents SDK 也很棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: But obviously, Cloudflare's business is like, they're a cloud, so you have to run the computer on the cloud.
zh: 但显然，Cloudflare 的生意是，他们是一家云服务，所以你必须在云上运行电脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what if you don't want to?
zh: 所以如果你不想怎么办？

speaker: Unknown
en: What if you want to own your own infrastructure?
zh: 如果你想拥有你自己的基础设施怎么办？

en: So that's also what we're doing, basically.
zh: 所以这也就是我们正在做的，基本上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Amazing.
zh: 太棒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。
